integrity: The proof is reconstructed from the one-step recursive-tree growth rule. A leaf-transmission auxiliary statistic closes the mixed-moment recursion, and an independent exhaustive parent-sequence checker verifies all trees through size nine.
scientific_limitations: The tree law is the standard uniform random recursive tree with unit edge lengths.
Leaves are outdegree-zero vertices in the rooted tree.
The theorem gives exact second moments but no stochastic monotonicity or full joint distribution.
title: Exact leaf–Wiener covariance in random recursive trees
